items.title: Tim Kelly Interview, 1979-03-26
items.q: I don't know, I don't, I really don't know the connection.

ctx.x: I don't know, I don't, I really don't know the connection. But, uh, but suits with the pom poms like, uh, carnival suits that they used in the audience. Uh, they used to call them yama yama suits. I don't know why. I don't know.

Yeah, well I have to check on that. Well, certain things become fads like, Yeah. Uh, Rudolph Valentino's style. I know they used to have chic suits, I've heard of. Even a certain way they were cut and things. Must have been an invitation of the chic Rudolph Valentino.
They used to have jazz model suits too.
